artDirection.target: commercial game key art / loading splash, not a low-poly scene test
artDirection.summary: A warm storybook city festival at twilight. The camera is cinematic and almost frontal, with a glowing oversized Ferris wheel, theatrical buildings, curved boulevard, foreground foliage, practical lights, bunting, skyline depth and a small hot-air balloon. The image should read like promotional game illustration rather than gameplay.
requiredQualities: glowing practical lights and Ferris wheel
rejectIf: looks like a plain low-poly blockout
reads as isolated assets placed on a stage
large empty green areas dominate the frame
all buildings are simple rectangular boxes with no silhouette variation
